format: JSON object; alternatively exactly one JSON object fenced in Markdown

rowRequired.terminalEvidence: repository-relative evidence path plus event id/time, or null with reason

exposure.recoveryMs: observed value or null; define derivation
exposure.inactivityMs: observed value or null; define derivation
exposure.observedContact: sampling interval, target types, simultaneous-contact support and gaps; episode membership alone is insufficient

farm.castsStarted: integer or null for on-hit ability/not observed
farm.castTimeMs: observed cast commitments; interrupted attempts included
farm.deliveryEvents: counts by event kind/adapter; an activation is not delivery
farm.secondaryTargets: observed count/distribution with attribution confidence or null
farm.sustainEligible: false for deaths, invalid or incomplete windows; full windows still do not establish long-run sustain

boss.chargeHitOverlap: array of {atMs, hitEvidence, chargeEvidence, braceActive: true|false|null, beforeRemainingMs, afterRemainingMs, reason}
boss.cooldownMisses: observed count plus evidence; not inferred from cast counts
boss.unattributedHits: retain all hits that cannot be assigned to a charge
boss.noHitChargeWindows: avoidance/cancellation/unfinished/unknown; do not assume every absent hit was dodged

conduit.applicability: T3 farming detailed; T4 boss progress contrasted separately; null for other roots
conduit.ownerMovement: sampled distance and intent distribution, explicitly sampled
conduit.targetPersistence: target switches, sustained damage gaps, HP regain and evidence
conduit.formation: active-body distribution, empty samples, distinct spawned IDs and rebuilding evidence
conduit.techniqueDelivery: arm/delivery/share-lost events, incomplete shares and evidence

rowRequired.comparison: opening outcome and exposure, complete package delta, source-compatible label; no isolated-component claim
rowRequired.unknowns: array of field/reason pairs; missing is never zero
rowRequired.evidence: repository-relative artifacts with SHA-256 and event/time locators

interpretationRules: Report all 36 planned IDs even when not executed. Reconcile counts without treating unused allocation as authorization to retry.
Separate observed facts, hypotheses and proposed next decisions.
Do not rank death-truncated kill rates as sustainable farming.
Boss alive at cap is unfinished, not a kill at cap. Victory requires authoritative kill evidence.
One reused seed is matched screening, not an independent repeat or win probability.
Brace is ability-guard. Stable positive pre/post tick status supports overlap. A boundary transition requires in-tick evidence or null, not interpolation.
Node-event sequence and world-log event id are separate ordering domains; do not order them by array position across streams.
Base mitigation.drBlocked excludes later onDamageTaken modifiers; do not infer exact Brace savings from it.
Keep incomplete casts, missed deliveries, failed processes and unknown attribution.
No more than six actionable findings; no automatically scheduled follow-up, tuning or integration.

publication.failurePolicy: Retain scoped commit and report push failure explicitly; do not imply repository availability.
